text:
Laura Chen: quick flag 10:08am - PR #4827 has inconsistent streaming examples: curl shows Content-Type application/json, JS fetch example merges headers incorrectly
Emilia (docs): ugh yeah looks like copy/paste. curl should NOT set Content-Type for GET SSE; fetch should set Accept: text/event-stream and omit Content-Type for GETs :facepalm:
Samir Patel: can you paste the bad snippets?
Laura Chen: heres the curl from the page:
``
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -H "X-Client-Meta: beta" \n  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate/stream?model=rw-large"
```
Ravi Kumar: that Content-Type causes some proxies to buffer and break chunked streaming. ops hit this in staging once and it was a mess
Emilia (docs): action items: (1) update api-ref streaming examples to show correct header sets for GET SSE vs POST chunked; (2) mark X-Client-Meta as optional with examples both with/without it; (3) add short troubleshooting note about proxies and Content-Type pitfalls
Laura Chen: I can take (1) and (2). will push small PR with curl/py/js variations today
Samir Patel: Ill add a JS SDK test to ensure fetch client omits Content-Type for SSE GETs and sets Accept header. will link PR when ready
Emilia (docs): Ill add a one-paragraph migration note and update the OpenAPI example file. adding comment to PR: "Do not set Content-Type for SSE GETs; set Accept: text/event-stream instead."
docs-bot: Reminder: docs PR template requires curl + py + js examples for streaming endpoint changes
Laura Chen: noted, py snippet will use requests.get(..., stream=True, headers=...) and show both with/without X-Client-Meta
Ravi Kumar: ops asked we call out reverse proxies (nginx, varnish) and how they may buffer on Content-Type/application/json
Emilia (docs): will add troubleshooting subheading: "Proxy buffering symptoms and quick fixes"
Samir Patel: ETA 1-2 hrs for SDK test + PR review
Laura Chen: PR link (when ready) will be dropped here for review
Emilia (docs): tagging @Samir @Ravi in PR description for reviews
Laura Chen: thanks all :rocket:
Samir Patel: :thumbsup:
Ravi Kumar: :ok_hand:
